script.stored_text_completeness: All 18529 canonical characters read sequentially in full in 1 bounded ranges; auto-generated untimed text; stored text ends on the close ("Uh, you have to circle it yourself.") with no separate sign-off; the composite is rendered as John and Jon; garbles include "least German SUV" (leased), "Medicare search charge", "steal man", "two-e trip", "ponded off" and "broken reality"; audio, timed delivery and editing unverified.
script.opening_words: It's two in the morning and John's phone lights up on the nightstand. Low balance alert. He swipes it away without reading the way you'd wave off a fly and falls back asleep in a house that cost more than most people earn in a decade. On paper, Jon is winning. $200,000 salary, least German SUV in the driveway. A job title that photographs beautifully on LinkedIn. Now meet Elena. Same company, same Monday start, same $200,000, same everything. Except
script.ending_words: life that looks incredible from the outside. It cannot buy you freedom. Only the number you keep can do that. The raise was never the prize. What you keep is the prize. And nobody, not the bank, not the dealership, not the guy swiping away a low balance alert at two in the morning is ever going to circle that number for you. Uh, you have to circle it yourself.
script.analysis: Full 18529 canonical characters read. A single-narrator story essay with two composites (John/Jon and Elena, same $200,000 salary): 2 a.m. hook, paycheck-to-paycheck survey data, the Bank of America account-data measure, taxes and geography, a steelman of the discipline argument, lifestyle creep and hedonic adaptation, the walk-away option, high-cost metros, fixed costs (daycare, car payments, vesting stock), mean vs median net worth and phantom wealth, under accumulators, the savings-rate comparison, a community promotion, comparison and moving goalposts, three fixes and a callback close. The savings-rate arithmetic reproduces; most statistics are directionally right but several are unsourced.
beat_map: Mean vs median net worth; phantom wealth.
